phase_measurement.scope: 31 samples per phase; prebuilt immutable bundles and warm global romanization tables. Publication construction, candidate_search_text formatting/validation, then Candidate::new indexing. Setup and final candidate destruction are excluded. Every sample compares all retained candidate fields, search spellings and readings against combined construction.
phase_measurement.caveat: Batched phases retain intermediate publications/search fields and an expected candidate vector. Allocation lifetimes differ from interleaved admission. Do not sum percentiles or substitute phase results for the combined gate.

sampling.workload: Separate run of the phase measurement command; sampled timings are not used as latency evidence.
sampling.finding: Combined candidate construction stacks include repeated RawVec growth/reallocation inside normalization::_without_isolates and romanized_readings. The trace also includes phase construction, equality checks and destruction; top-of-stack totals do not isolate admission latency.
sampling.next_candidates: Measure romanization temporary vector construction and the Fluent integer formatter before choosing further changes.

buffer_change.description: Reserve the original input byte length once when removing Unicode isolates; removing characters cannot exceed that bound. Inputs without isolates remain borrowed. No cache or retained representation changes.
buffer_change.scope: Uninstrumented combined latency and separately instrumented requested heap. Excludes shared resource bundles, global romanization tables, allocator overhead, transport, durable storage and native/WebView memory. Query rows measure matches and heap, not latency.
